titleEn: Add Edges to Make Degrees of All Nodes Even
title: 添加边使所有节点度数都为偶数
summary: 简单无向图中最多添加两条不存在的边，问能否让所有节点度数变为偶数。
insight: 添加一条边只翻转两个端点的度数奇偶性，所以奇度节点数只能是 0、2 或 4。两个奇点可直接相连或借一个共同中间点；四个奇点只需检查三种两两配对是否都为非边。
pitfalls: 不能添加自环或已有边
奇度节点超过四必定无解
借中间点时它与两个奇点都必须尚未相连
四奇点共有三种配对方式

solutions.title: 枚举奇度节点配对
solutions.idea: 奇点很少，可常数次检查缺失边。
steps: 建立每个节点的邻接集合并收集 odd
odd 为空返回 true，数量非 2/4 返回 false
两个奇点 a,b：若 a-b 不存在返回 true；否则枚举第三点 c 检查 a-c、b-c 都不存在
四奇点检查 (a,b)(c,d)、(a,c)(b,d)、(a,d)(b,c) 任一配对

code.java: class Solution { private List<Set<Integer>> graph;private boolean missing(int a,int b){return !graph.get(a).contains(b);}public boolean isPossible(int n,List<List<Integer>> edges){graph=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)graph.add(new HashSet<>());for(List<Integer> edge:edges){int a=edge.get(0)-1,b=edge.get(1)-1;graph.get(a).add(b);graph.get(b).add(a);}List<Integer> odd=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)if(graph.get(i).size()%2==1)odd.add(i);if(odd.isEmpty())return true;if(odd.size()==2){int a=odd.get(0),b=odd.get(1);if(missing(a,b))return true;for(int c=0;c<n;c++)if(c!=a&&c!=b&&missing(a,c)&&missing(b,c))return true;return false;}if(odd.size()!=4)return false;int a=odd.get(0),b=odd.get(1),c=odd.get(2),d=odd.get(3);return missing(a,b)&&missing(c,d)||missing(a,c)&&missing(b,d)||missing(a,d)&&missing(b,c);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun isPossible(n:Int,edges:List<List<Int>>):Boolean{val graph=Array(n){HashSet<Int>()};for(edge in edges){val a=edge[0]-1;val b=edge[1]-1;graph[a].add(b);graph[b].add(a)};val odd=(0 until n).filter{graph[it].size%2==1};fun missing(a:Int,b:Int):Boolean{return b !in graph[a]};if(odd.isEmpty())return true;if(odd.size==2){val a=odd[0];val b=odd[1];if(missing(a,b))return true;return (0 until n).any{it!=a&&it!=b&&missing(a,it)&&missing(b,it)}};if(odd.size!=4)return false;val (a,b,c,d)=odd;return missing(a,b)&&missing(c,d)||missing(a,c)&&missing(b,d)||missing(a,d)&&missing(b,c)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:bool isPossible(int n,vector<vector<int>>& edges){vector<unordered_set<int>> graph(n);for(auto& edge:edges){int a=edge[0]-1,b=edge[1]-1;graph[a].insert(b);graph[b].insert(a);}vector<int> odd;for(int i=0;i<n;++i)if(graph[i].size()%2)odd.push_back(i);auto missing=[&](int a,int b){return !graph[a].count(b);};if(odd.empty())return true;if(odd.size()==2){int a=odd[0],b=odd[1];if(missing(a,b))return true;for(int c=0;c<n;++c)if(c!=a&&c!=b&&missing(a,c)&&missing(b,c))return true;return false;}if(odd.size()!=4)return false;int a=odd[0],b=odd[1],c=odd[2],d=odd[3];return missing(a,b)&&missing(c,d)||missing(a,c)&&missing(b,d)||missing(a,d)&&missing(b,c);} };
